dataset.name: serein-public-metadata-pilot-2026-10-05
dataset.split_unit: scripted journey, disjoint by topic; common candidate corpus includes all 49 documents

synthetic_timing.rationale: Minimum valid visit duration for policy admission; not observed dwell or user behavior.

fixture.vaults: disposable temporary data roots and homes, removed after the run

limitations: All retrieval judgments are the frozen synthetic metadata-only labels, not independently verified human relevance or user outcomes.
The source pilot was previously inspected and is regression material, not a fresh holdout.
No candidate pool or admission trace is exposed by the production recall wire response.
Foreground time and replay timestamp are synthetic and must not be interpreted as observed behavior.
OS file-cache eviction was not forced; report first process/on-read separately from warm samples.
RSS is per short-lived CLI child process on this host, not a reference-machine peak or browser integration measurement.

method.candidate_recall_and_admission_loss: not observable through the supported recall packet; no proxy inferred from final context
method.first_read: measured before explicit refresh on each version's independent copy of the same unindexed vault snapshot
method.group_definition: qrel source identity grouped by hostname + title; attainable denominator models the two-per-site and six-record caps, not cross-site canonical payload dedup
method.warm_samples: fresh CLI process per sample; all after completed index; OS file cache warmed by prior operations, no cache eviction

export_note: Local filesystem paths omitted; measured results unchanged.
evaluation_role: seen regression after performance-only check reordering; not a fresh acceptance test
